PP001.title: Shadows Over Harrow's Hollow
PP001.playerDescription: You arrived in Harrow's Hollow, a small village gripped by fear, and helped Elder Mirna Harrow investigate the disappearances, including Scout Elen's. By gathering rumors and earning the villagers' trust, you uncovered the truth behind the whispers of curses, spirits, and the haunted Keep of Doom.
PP001.originalDescription: The party arrives in Harrow's Hollow, a small, anxious village gripped by fear. Elder Mirna Harrow asks the characters to investigate recent disappearances, including that of Scout Elen. Tensions run high as rumors of curses, spirits, and the haunted Keep of Doom swirl among the villagers. Players must gather information, win trust, and follow leads to piece together the mystery.

SQ002.title: Trouble at the Hearth
SQ002.playerDescription: You calmed the restless spirit haunting Cira the Innkeeper's cellar. In gratitude, Cira shared a clue about Scout Elen's last known movements.

PP002.title: The Road to Doom
PP002.playerDescription: You followed the trail through the haunted forest to the Keep of Doom, braving treacherous ground, spectral ambushes, and lingering wards. Unnatural forces stirred among the trees, and every step brought you closer to the keep.
PP002.originalDescription: Tracking clues and rumors, the party must brave the haunted forest and reach the Keep of Doom. Along the way, they navigate treacherous terrain, spectral ambushes, and lingering wards. The forest is alive with unnatural energies, and the party may encounter allies or enemies who help or hinder their journey.

SQ003.title: The Lost Ward Circle
SQ003.playerDescription: You restored the ancient ward circle hidden in the forest, weakening the keep's influence and shielding Harrow's Hollow from further spectral incursions.

PP003.title: Breach the Keep
PP003.playerDescription: You stand before the foreboding Keep of Doom. Find a way inside while overcoming traps, magical defenses, and spectral guardians -- whether through cunning, courage, or a key won from earlier encounters.
PP003.originalDescription: The party reaches the foreboding Keep of Doom. They must find a way inside, dealing with traps, lingering magical defenses, and spectral guardians. Entry requires cunning, bravery, or the right key--perhaps obtained from earlier encounters.

PP004.title: The Heart of Darkness
PP004.playerDescription: Deep within the keep, you confronted the vengeful spirit of Lord Thaddeus Greymont, whose soul had been corrupted by dark magic. Through combat, exorcism, or the fulfillment of his final wish, you brought the curse to an end.
PP004.originalDescription: Within the keep's depths lies the source of the curse: the vengeful spirit of Lord Thaddeus Greymont, corrupted by dark magic. The party must confront him, either by combat, exorcism, or fulfilling his final wish to find peace.

PP005.title: Resolution and Rewards
PP005.playerDescription: The curse has been lifted, and you have returned to Harrow's Hollow as a hero. Elder Mirna and the villagers celebrate your deeds, while rewards, new allies, and fresh opportunities await as your reputation spreads.
PP005.originalDescription: With the curse lifted, the party returns to Harrow's Hollow as heroes. Elder Mirna and the villagers celebrate their success. Rewards, both material and social, await. New opportunities and adventures may present themselves as the party's reputation spreads.
